preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.
native_verification: tests/native_verifier.py: actual exit, registered test completion, raw ordered logs, unchanged snapshots, identical binary repeated three times.
build_selection: CMake explicitly selects the activity settings handler and proto/zmk/settings/core.proto. The removed zmk.template sample had no registered handler or client and owned no executable assertion; the settings wire protocol and retained assertions are unchanged.

web_session.contract: Connection/index/catalog retirement, request deadline cleanup, delayed sync refresh cancellation, preserved unsaved drafts and explicit refresh replacement.
web_session.regression: Original editor: 13 failing cases and 8 positive controls; existing assertions retained with only mock-client import changes.
web_session.limits: Controlled RPC/DOM; no device-side cancellation, rollback or physical delivery acceptance.
